gen-dafont-bebas-kai-fs-erode: Tight, tall, and unfussy up top: Bebas Kai packs its letters into a compact line with steady pressure throughout. Erode, a text serif, takes over with a gentle ebb and flow in its strokes that never thins to a razor hair.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-cascadia-mono: Blockletter has a tall, squat belly, like a brush pen drawn with a pencil that never presses harder. Cascadia Mono then stands its letters like pins in a wide board, so a long page moves at a steady, orderly pace.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-julius-sans-on: Precise in a sketched, pencil-light way, Blockletter carries a tall midsection that gives the heading its own rounded belly. Julius Sans One is the plain sans partner, and its generous gaps give the pair its breathing room.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-exa: Blockletter leads with a tall midsection, like a squat brush-pen belly, drawn in pencil without ever pressing harder. Lexend Exa follows with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, and that sturdy, wide-curved body is the pair's real strength.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-giga: A squat, brush-pen belly in the middle of each letter marks Blockletter apart from anything flat. Lexend Giga then spaces its single-weight lines generously, so a longer passage moves along in slow, open steps.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable as it is, Blockletter still holds a precise, pencil-sketched shape with a tall, rounded midsection throughout. Lexend Mega, a plain sans, draws everything with one nib and keeps its c's visibly open.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-peta: Blockletter sketches its tall, squat-bellied letters in pencil. Lexend Peta, a sans with a big x-height and curves that never thin, gives the pair its strongest quality: sturdy, wide-mouthed clarity beneath a hand-drawn heading.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera draws a single-weight line like a plotter pen, with letters set apart like stepping stones. Lexend Tera's open curves then sit under Blockletter's pencil-sketched, tall-bellied heading, a hand-drawn top over a mechanical, spacious body.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta cuts its strokes like ribbon of constant width, with tall small letters and wide tracking. Blockletter, with its squat brush-pen belly, makes a good heading above it, and the body would suit a modest size.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-montserrat-alt: Chunky, pencil-drawn and precise, Blockletter shows a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly up top. Blockletter does the shouting; Montserrat Alternates, a plain sans, keeps its rims matched to the stems.
